seed.question: How did Discover Financial Service’s Gross Profit Margin for 2023 compare to the previous year?
seed.ground_truth_answer:
Discover Financial Services: Gross Profit Margin Analysis
Gross Profit Margin Calculation for 2023
Gross Profit=Net Interest Income+Other Income−Provision for Credit Losses Gross Profit=$13,099 million+$2,761 million−$6,018 million=$9,842 million
Total Revenue=Net Interest Income+Other Income Total Revenue=$13,099 million+$2,761 million=$15,860 million
Gross Profit Margin=Gross Profit/Total Revenue×100
Gross Profit Margin=9,842/15,860×100 = 62.1%

Gross Profit Margin for 2022:
Gross Profit=$10,999 million+$2,294 million−$2,359 million=$10,934 million
Total Revenue=$10,999 million+$2,294 million=$13,293 million
Gross Profit Margin=10,934/13,293×100 = 82.2%
